purpose: Define one general, reusable, fail-closed Whale Intelligence flow using existing components without creating a second engine, product-specific code, patch chain, live fetch, runtime binding, or database mutation.

normalized_whale_flow_event_contract.unknown_value_rule: Missing economic or attribution context remains explicit UNKNOWN and cannot be converted to zero, safe, or real-whale truth.
normalized_whale_flow_event_contract.source_rule: Only explicitly approved read-only source classes may produce normalized events. Source registration is not runtime eligibility.

evidence: bounded graph depth and node limits

component_reuse_map.component: whale_entity_registry_v1 and related Whale schema tables
component_reuse_map.evidence: Schema and indexes exist; row counts were zero at post-audit.

component_reuse_map.component: known-wallet source registry and CEX classification artifacts
component_reuse_map.rule: External or registry labels cannot create final entity truth without onchain behavior and evidence cross-check.
Continue to show DATA_MISSING when no validated flow exists; never convert missing data to zero activity.
Prefer precomputed summaries; no heavy graph traversal on consumer path.

source_adapter_gate: no API or RPC until separate approval
graph_core_gate: existing core imported rather than copied
attribution_gate: sniper, MEV, wash and sybil classes cannot be promoted to smart money without outcome evidence
economic_impact_gate: transfer value evaluated against liquidity or route depth
missing or stale depth yields REVIEW_REQUIRED
single source cannot create central alarm
evidence_risk_gate: risk link cannot grant trade authority
unresolved evidence remains blocking or review-required
News and Technical inputs are cross-checks, not authority
readmodel_gate: trade, paper and live flags false
DATA_MISSING preserved when producer chain is absent

duplicate_and_retirement_decision.rule: No active component may be retired until replacement parity, consumer migration, fail-closed behavior, and rollback evidence are measured.
duplicate_and_retirement_decision.conditional_retirement_candidate: tools/whale_center_live_producer_v1.py only after a validated general small-readmodel producer fully replaces its DATA_MISSING duty.
duplicate_and_retirement_decision.archive_cleanup: Historical plan and audit artifacts are not executable duplicates. Cleanup requires a separate dependency and canonical-reference audit; no deletion is authorized here.

implementation_decision.reason: No measured evidence yet proves that the existing graph core interface cannot consume a normalized general event through a thin boundary.

acceptance_criteria_for_future_bounded_d: fixture or approved local read-only input only
same normalized event contract across chains
existing graph core imported without copied threshold logic
zero runtime, DB, panel, service and network mutation
no new permanent script unless a reusable general capability is proven necessary
